requirements.description: Deliver the temperature export module for Harbor Metrics release 1.2.0.
requirements.acceptance: Delivery and completion records identify release 1.2.0 and confirm the CSV export module was delivered and completed.
requirements.violation: A delivery or completion record affirmatively identifies a different release as the delivered release.

requirements.description: Pass all 12 export regression cases before acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: The test record reports all 12 regression cases passing, and the acceptance record explicitly accepts those passing results.
requirements.violation: The test record affirmatively reports one or more failed export regression cases for the delivered release.
